text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Number of half-hours whose flow is beyond the limit, by season. The published thermal limit is a ceiling NGED does not operate to; each scaled limit (0.9, 0.75 or 0.5 times the node's maximum before 2025-07-02) stands in for the headroom NGED keeps. All history is 2019-09 (Skegness, Bicker Fen) or 2022-07 (Boston) to 2026-06-30; the scored year is 2025-07-02 to 2026-06-30. * Bicker Fen's sign is unconfirmed, and its thermal limit is a Technical Limit. No published import limit is used. Thermal limits are NGED's, Supported by NGED Open Data.'
text.tspan: Number of half-hours whose flow is beyond the limit, by season. The published thermal limit is a
ceiling NGED does not operate to; each scaled limit (0.9, 0.75 or 0.5 times the node's maximum
before 2025-07-02) stands in for the headroom NGED keeps. All history is 2019-09 (Skegness, Bicker
Fen) or 2022-07 (Boston) to 2026-06-30; the scored year is 2025-07-02 to 2026-06-30. * Bicker Fen's
sign is unconfirmed, and its thermal limit is a Technical Limit. No published import limit is used.
Thermal limits are NGED's, Supported by NGED Open Data.
